items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: I have a command by the President of the Republic, Kemal Attaturk Pasha, asking to send my orchestra to Ankara

ctx.x: because I'd seen him in London, and I'd seen him -- he was much older than I was, you know. I saw him in England, and I was glad to be meeting him in Turkey. And we had a very nice time. He had a very fine show, and there was no problem, until one evening playing at the Petite Chaut in Paris itself, Mr. Lehmann sent for me to come to his office. I went to his office and there was an officer, a Turkish officer, and he said to me, he said, "Mr. Briggs, tomorrow we have a very, very big gala evening." I said, "Yes."…
